title: Osmo Studio — word-per-shot launch teaser

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; backgrounds loop on their own (particles, HUD boxes, ink growth) while the type is still
color: saturated neon and posterized backgrounds on a near-black base; varies shot to shot
typography: one tiny lowercase grotesk word, centered, never animated
shape_language: organic blobs, ink smoke, doves, particles and light forms, plus some precise UI
character_humor: no characters; a dry line ('without the slop') and silhouettes

signature: A tiny, motionless centered word over a new animated visual every 1.083 s: the sentence is read across metronomic cuts, then the hero visual reappears inside the product UI.

music.summary: 107.7 BPM low-percussion bed with a fairly clear pulse; the edit cuts on a metronomic 1.083 s clock (~2 beats at 110.8 BPM), so cuts drift across the beat instead of locking (on beat 25% = chance, on half-beat 67%).

family_note: A showreel of the tool's possible outputs, cut to a regular rhythm, saturated and varied: Playful reel in intent, but at mid energy (4.4) and with deadpan tiny type and no springs. Could also sit in Mixed media (footage + generative + UI), but it lacks texture/collage layering. Proposed sub-style 'Minimal word-per-shot showreel'.

behaviors.mechanism: one small lowercase word, centered, changes with each background cut; no fade, no motion; the sentence is read across shots
behaviors.notes: Hold = scene length 1.083 s (measured, 65 f @60). Words: animate / your / story / like a / pro / create / keyframe / polish / animate.

behaviors.mechanism: hard cut to a new animated background on a fixed 1.083 s clock (≈2 beats at 110.8 BPM); drifts against the 107.7 BPM track instead of locking
behaviors.notes: 7 identical intervals 1.083 s (4.33–10.83 s). Phase vs librosa beats: −0.45 → +0.50 → +0.23 beat. Music-sync behavior: regular, but not phase-locked.

behaviors.mechanism: thin rectangles follow each flying dove (computer-vision tracking HUD over footage)
behaviors.notes: 2.2–3.3 s, also on the opening mirrored footage. Read from sheet a.

behaviors.mechanism: camera flies through a 3D line network with radial blur, dims nearly to black mid-shot and bursts again
behaviors.notes: 5.42–6.5 s; dim at ~5.8 s, near beat 5.67 s (not verified as sync).

behaviors.mechanism: each shot is a different self-moving visual (particle ring breathing, ink smoke growing, gradient blobs drifting, neon light form waving) while the type stays still
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets a–c. 'Backgrounds move, type stays still.'

behaviors.mechanism: after showing the neon X visual full-frame, cut to the same visual inside the product editor UI (layers, sliders, timeline) with a small push
behaviors.notes: 9.75 s full-frame → 12.3 s inside UI (hold to 15.17 s). Duration = UI shot length (measured from scene changes).

behaviors.mechanism: key lines on a plain near-black card, small centered type, no animation, held 1.5–2.2 s
behaviors.notes: 'without the slop' 10.83–12.3 s, 'make stories that move' 15.17–17.4 s (times from scene changes / overview).

behaviors.mechanism: red wordmark cut on and held ~2.3 s, then cut to a small URL card held to the end
behaviors.notes: 17.4–19.7 s logo, 19.7–21.6 s osmo.inc. No logo animation visible in sheets.
